AI Overview
You can play Scrandle, a daily food-guessing game, directly in your web browser. 
Scrandle
 +1
How to Play
The Goal: Each day, you are shown two different stadium or matchday meals ("scran") and asked to guess which one received a higher community approval rating from online polls. 
What to Look At: Compare the price, country of origin, presentation, and extras of each dish rather than just picking what you personally prefer to eat. 
Streaks: Make a correct choice to build your daily streak, or start back at zero if you miss. 
Game Modes:
Random Mode: Practice mode with custom options.
Evil Mode: Turns all food images into grayscale to remove color and cheese clues.
Scrandle 2: Features preloaded images, currency conversions, and a Scran Level progression system.
